title: Let the worker driver run one continuation turn on a blockerless stop
body:
Outcome: when a turn ends with exit 4 "worker report status <s> names no blocker", `krn worker start|send` sends one bounded continuation turn in the same thread (counted against the D13 three-turn and 1M uncached budget) that lists the brief's unmet proof, before returning exit 4.
Evidence: t-t8v24zs slice (PR #185): two gpt-6-luna turns stopped early (20 s, 6 tool calls; 60 s, 666 output tokens) and the lead finished by hand; `.krn/runs/lead/worker-turn-finish/{stop-cause.md,rounds}`. A manual continuation (msg-2.md) also stopped early, so measure first: record whether the new instructions (#185) alone reduce blockerless stops over the next five worker turns before building this.
Proof: fixture turn returning partial-empty then done ends exit 0 after two turns; a second blockerless stop exits 4.
